name: @olai/bundle
//name: The application composition boundary. olai.yml selects plugin rows; generated descriptors and assets follow that list. General host packages know the bundle interface, while feature integrations depend on explicit contracts owned by their providers.
//exports: The root exposes inert row metadata and browser module loaders; ./bundle mounts selected rows. ./assets and ./all.css describe build assets. ./testids merges identifiers exported by their rendering owners. ./surface, ./faces and ./client are the complete application contract and compatibility clients for CLI/tests, assembled from provider-owned descriptors; the permanent browser wire imports only the management Surface. ./inputs adapts product boot inputs and ticket lookup into the generic host without importing capability implementations there. The import fence checks these closures independently.
//: olai.yml owns row selection; generate.ts derives browser rows, style routing and the test ID catalogue. Application contract composition is explicit in ./surface and ./faces. Plugins never depend on the bundle; their contracts remain safe to import without activating their implementations.
//dependencies: This build declares every selected plugin so generated dynamic imports resolve. Static provider contracts are used only in application composition doors; browser and server entry graphs never acquire feature implementations merely by importing a catalogue. The Cordis runtime arrives through @olai/effect-cordis and the pinned dependency hydration, not direct framework imports. effect describes contributed schemas.
